clue.text: Ceremony has a specific purpose

definitions.meaning: a formal occasion or official gathering
the particular job something is meant to do

explanation.surface: A ritual is said to exist for one particular reason.
explanation.definitionFit: A formal social event is a function, and so is the role or job a thing is designed to perform.

clue.text: Look, we must return after six

indicators.note: after places the word we behind the numeral six

parts.note: VI is six in Roman numerals

indicators.note: return tells us the word we is read backwards

explanation.surface: An instruction to look, since we have to come back after six o'clock.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Look' reads as an interjection opening the sentence, but it is the definition; 'must return' and 'after' are the two indicators.
explanation.definitionFit: A view is a look or a sight of something, as in taking a view of the scene.

clue.text: Grumbled when industrious worker took a meal

parts.note: the bee is the proverbial hard worker
fed means ate, had a meal

explanation.surface: Someone complained when a hard-working employee went off to eat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Grumbled' is slang BEEFED; the grid's P is a misprint, since BEEPED means sounded a horn and nothing in the clue gives PED.
explanation.definitionFit: To beef is informal slang for complaining, so having beefed is having moaned.

clue.text: Apartments initially purchased in a state of panic

parts.note: flats are apartments in British usage

indicators.note: initially asks for the opening letter of the word purchased

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Flats bought on impulse leave a buyer feeling anxious.
explanation.definitionFit: A flat spin is an informal idiom for a state of agitated confusion, from an aircraft spinning out of control.

clue.text: Wearing priestly robe for clerical inauguration

parts.note: in means wearing, as in dressed in black
a vestment is a garment worn by clergy at services

explanation.surface: A priest wears his robes for the ceremony that installs a cleric.
explanation.definitionFit: Investment is an old word for investiture, the formal installing of someone in a church office.

clue.text: Subaltern without merit gets found out

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside, so the officer's letters go round the word for merit

parts.note: LT is the abbreviation for lieutenant, a subaltern rank in the army
to earn something is to merit it

explanation.surface: A junior officer who lacks merit is exposed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' looks like lacking, but here it carries its old sense of outside, so the officer abbreviation wraps the synonym for merit.
explanation.definitionFit: Having found out a fact means having learnt it, discovered it.

clue.text: Commerce is a difficult affair

definitions.meaning: trade, the buying and selling of goods

explanation.surface: Trading is described as a hard thing to deal with.
explanation.definitionFit: Business means trade in general and also a matter or situation, often a troublesome one.

clue.text: April's wild wind

indicators.note: wild suggests the letters of April's running out of control into a new order

explanation.surface: Spring weather brings an untamed breeze in the fourth month.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wind' looks like a breeze, but is the verb, to coil.
explanation.definitionFit: To spiral is to wind round and round in a coil.

clue.text: He yearns for more time

definitions.meaning: one who yearns or pines for something

explanation.surface: A man who wishes for extra time.
explanation.definitionFit: One who longs is, whimsically, a longer; and longer also means for a greater length of time.

clue.text: Boat built by firm in the South West

indicators.note: in puts the firm's letters inside the compass abbreviation

parts.note: SW is the abbreviation for south-west
CO is short for company, a firm

explanation.surface: A vessel constructed by a company based in the West Country.
explanation.definitionFit: A scow is a flat-bottomed boat used for carrying cargo.

clue.text: "--ne'erwana ladyfair. (Burns)

parts.note: a fill-in-the-blank quotation: the missing two words complete the proverb Robert Burns quotes about timid suitors

explanation.surface: A line of Burns with its first two words left out.
explanation.definitionFit: The proverb says timidity never wins a beloved; the missing words name the cowardly spirit.

clue.text: Evil, evil sailor

parts.note: sin is wrongdoing, evil
bad means evil, wicked

explanation.surface: A wicked, wicked seaman.
explanation.definitionFit: Sinbad is the legendary seafarer of the Arabian Nights tales.

clue.text: Crazy family is a potential hazard

parts.note: bananas is slang for crazy
kin are one's relatives

explanation.surface: A mad household is a danger to others.
explanation.definitionFit: A discarded fruit peel is the classic slipping danger of comedy, hence anything likely to trip one up.

clue.text: Longing for a piano of dainty frame

parts.note: P is the musical abbreviation for piano, softly
petite describes a person of small, dainty build

explanation.surface: A desire for a small, delicately built piano.
explanation.definitionFit: Appetite is a craving or desire for something.

clue.text: No horse has energy in immaturity

parts.note: a nag is an old or poor horse
E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: Lacking a horse with any spirit while still young.
explanation.definitionFit: Nonage is the period of being under legal age, youth and immaturity.

clue.text: Give news to single supporter with good humour

parts.note: gen is British slang for information or news
I is the Roman numeral one, single
an ally is a supporter

explanation.surface: Pass on information to a lone backer in a cheerful manner.
explanation.definitionFit: Genially means in a friendly, cheerful and good-natured way.

clue.text: Really popular action

parts.note: in means fashionable or popular
a deed is an act or action

explanation.surface: A truly well-liked move.
explanation.definitionFit: Indeed is used to stress truth, much like truly or in fact.

clue.text: Gift for the same local

parts.note: do, short for ditto, means the same again
a native is a local inhabitant

explanation.surface: A present given to a neighbour on equal terms.
explanation.definitionFit: A donative is a donation or present, especially an official one.

clue.text: Fresh schism besetting Anglican church

indicators.note: besetting means surrounding, so the split goes round the church

parts.note: a rent is a split or division, a schism
CE stands for the Church of England

explanation.surface: A new split surrounds the Church of England.
explanation.definitionFit: Recent means new or lately happened, synonym of fresh.

clue.text: Cardinal distinction

definitions.meaning: a cardinal is addressed as His ..., so the title stands for the prelate

explanation.surface: A churchman's honour.
explanation.definitionFit: Cardinals of the Roman Church are styled by this title, which also means high rank or renown.

clue.text: Backed Red Rum and made a killing

indicators.note: backed means read in the backward direction, punning on betting on a horse

explanation.surface: Someone bet on the famous racehorse and won a fortune.
explanation.walkthrough: Red Rum was a celebrated Grand National winning horse, so 'Backed' and 'made a killing' look like betting; 'Backed' turns its letters round.
explanation.definitionFit: Murder is an unlawful killing.

clue.text: Obvious way to protect one's invention

definitions.meaning: the legal right granted to an inventor

explanation.surface: An evident method of guarding a new idea.
explanation.definitionFit: Patent means plainly evident, and is also the government grant giving an inventor exclusive rights.

clue.text: Annoyed at being inconvenienced

explanation.surface: Irritated at being put to trouble.
explanation.definitionFit: Being put out means feeling offended, and also being caused extra bother.

clue.text: Publicity man has to constrain a fellow

parts.note: to press someone is to force or constrain them
a gent is a man, a fellow

explanation.surface: A promoter must force a man into something.
explanation.definitionFit: A press agent is employed to get publicity for a client.

clue.text: Stay back to get utensils

indicators.note: back means the word for stay is turned round

parts.note: to stop is to stay or remain

explanation.surface: Wait behind to collect kitchenware.
explanation.definitionFit: Pots are cooking vessels, kitchen utensils.

clue.text: Hide zip

explanation.surface: Conceal a fastener.
explanation.definitionFit: A pelt is an animal's skin, and to pelt is to run or speed along.

clue.text: Servile male in dire distress

indicators.note: dire distress suggests letters thrown into disorder and rearranged

explanation.surface: A man in desperate trouble behaves like a lackey.
explanation.definitionFit: Menial means lowly and servile, fit for a servant.

clue.text: Sweetheart, it's time to regret nothing

parts.note: to rue is to regret
love is zero in tennis scoring

explanation.surface: A lover is told it is time to stop having regrets.
explanation.definitionFit: A true love is one's beloved or sweetheart.
